# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from operator import attrgetter
from typing import List

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


def _check(students: List[Student]) -> None:
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")


def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows of name, section and email in columns, sorted by name."""
    _check(students)
    ordered = sorted(students, key=attrgetter("display_name"))
    cells = [(s.display_name, s.section, s.email) for s in ordered]
    widths = [max(len(row[i]) for row in cells) for i in range(3)]
    return ["  ".join(v.ljust(w) for v, w in zip(row, widths)).rstrip() for row in cells]
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


def student(last, first, section, email):
    return Student("1", last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            student("Young", "Al", "B", "al@x.org"),
            student("Adams", "Beth", "A", "b@x.org")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, ["Adams, Beth  A  b@x.org", "Young, Al    B  al@x.org"])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProjectError, "Adams, Beth"):
            contact_rows([student("Adams", "Beth", "A", None)])

    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
